work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Core contributor across Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, and Tailpipe with 120+ merged pull requests and 9,300+ combined GitHub stars, building and shipping customer-facing product features from idea to production.

Designed and developed a secure REST API microservice in Go (Gin), implemented OAuth 2.0 via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed on AWS EC2, and integrated as a gRPC client with internal services.
Built a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline with asynchronous consumers and dead-letter queue handling for policy-enforcement workflows, improving reliability and operability in production.

Engineered high-volume data-processing features in Tailpipe (Go + DuckDB + Parquet), improving throughput by 30% to 1,000+ logs/second and preventing out-of-memory failures through memory-safe processing changes.
Kept release and CI pipelines current by adding multi-distro Linux smoke tests in GitHub Actions and owning release workflows across four Go CLIs.
Debugged and resolved production issues, including a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff incident, by tracing root causes via pod and service diagnostics and restoring service availability.
